scene: The metallic DJ bobs its chrome head and offers a neon cassette.
picture: A flat side view along a level carpeted corridor. On the left stands the silver-haired boy in his mint hoodie and dance bag. In the centre, a boxy robot DJ smiles on an LED face screen, extending a glowing cyan cassette tape. On the deck beside it spins a holographic vinyl. On the far right rises a yellow ladder.
shown: a bright cyan cassette tape held out by the DJ in the centre
a spinning holographic vinyl record on the deck to the left of centre
a tall yellow ladder bolted to the wall on the far right
